interfaces.Name: GPSSensorPosition

interfaces.Description:
Internal GPS sensor information.

Data members description:
Latitude -> Latitude is the angular distance of a place North or South of the earth's equator, range:[-90, +90], unit: Degree

Longitude -> Longitude is the angular distance of a place East or West of the meridian, range:[-180, +180], unit: Degree

Altitude -> How high or low the device/location is relation to the sea level, unit: meters

TimeStamp -> Epoch time when the GPS data transmitted from satellite, unit: milliseconds

HorizontalAccuracy -> Measure of how close a reported position is accurate on earth surface, unit: meters              

VerticalAccuracy -> Measure of how close a reported position is accurate to sea level, unit: meters

HorizontalDil -> Horizontal Dilution of precision, range:[1, infinity]

PositionDil -> Position Dilution of Precision, range:[1, infinity] (RCU target doest not provide PDOP, set to default value -99.999)

VerticalDil -> Vertical Dilution of Precision, range:[1, infinity]

TimeDil -> Time Dilution of Precision, range:[1, infinity]

Speed -> Speed of the GPS device, unit: km/hr

Course -> Direction in which the device is heading to, range:[0, 359.99], unit: Degree

NumberOfSatellites -> Number of satellites used in determining GPS fix




Data members
[
    Latitude  -> Default value -99.99
    Longitude -> Default value -99.99
    Altitude  -> Default value -99.99
    PacketTime (Epoch time of GPS data reception) -> Default value "0"
    Horizontal Accuracy -> Default value -99.99
    Vertical Accuracy-> Default value -99.99
    Horizontal Dilution of Precision -> Default value -99.99
    Position Dilution of Precision -> Default value -99.99
    Vertical Dilution of Precision -> Default value -99.99
    Time Dilution of Precision -> Default value -99.99
    Speed -> Default value -99.99
    Course -> Default value -99.99
    Number of Satellites -> Default value 0
]

If no GPS signal is available, the data members will be holding "null" value. 
If GPS signal is available, and some data members are not available from the GPS sensor, then those data members will be taking default values.
